description: This file defines a UI component named 'CartPanel' for a shopping cart interface in a LightningJS framework project. It manages cart item display, interaction (add/remove/update), and overlay confirmation dialogs, integrating with external store ('cartStore') for state management.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position of a cart entry row based on index.

methods.name: $entryAt
methods.description: Returns the cart entry at a specified index or null if none.

methods.name: $entryId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the cart entry at the specified index.

methods.name: $entryQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the cart entry at the specified index as a string.

methods.name: $entryName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the cart entry at a given index.

methods.name: $entryImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image URL of the cart entry at a given index.

methods.name: $entryPriceLabel
methods.description: Provides the formatted price label for the cart entry at a given index.

methods.name: $entryLineTotalLabel
methods.description: Provides the line total label for the cart entry at a given index.

methods.name: $incByIndex
methods.description: Increments the quantity of a cart entry by index.

methods.name: $decByIndex
methods.description: Decrements the quantity of a cart entry, removing it if zero.

methods.name: $removeByIndex
methods.description: Removes the cart entry at the specified index.

methods.name: $clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: $checkout
methods.description: Simulates a checkout, clears the cart, and shows confirmation overlay.

methods.name: $closeConfirm
methods.description: Closes the confirmation overlay with a fade-out effect.
